description:
First release

## Change points from original RVX patches v2.160.1

### Fixes
- `disable-haptic-feedback`: Support 17.34.36
- `hide-create-button`: Support 17.34.36 (rolled back the patch to 2.152.0)
- `enable-minimized-playback`: Support 17.34.36
  - The integrated `disable-shorts-pip` patch is removed because Android 8.0 or below don't support PiP.

### New features
- `enable-open-links-directly` patch now applies to all URLs, not just video descriptions (backport from 2.162.1)
- Add `switch-create-notification` patch (backport from 2.164.15)
- Add `enable-new-layout` 
  - This patch sppofs app version to 18.05.40.
  - This feature was inspired by https://github.com/cuynu/ytvanced/wiki/17.34.36-(Android-6-and-7) . Thank you cuynu !
- Add `force-enable-new-layout` patch
  - If this patch is applied, force spoof to 18.05.40
- Add `hide-shorts-pivot-bar` (backport from 2.164.21, Experimental, Works only with new layout)
- Add `protobuf-spoof` patch (backport from 2.166.4)

### Other changes
- Renamed `hide-pip-notification` to `hide-firsttime-background-notification` (because Android below 8.0 does not support PiP)
- Removed `double-back-to-close` patch because it does not work on 17.34.36
- Restore `Restore add-missing-translation-patch` from 2.152.1
- Music patches were removed (For YT Music, use the official RVX patches. It is available on Android 5.0+.)
